fields.Name: T106 - Parameterized Query Execution Round-Trip
fields.Description: Exercises the query-parameter-form typed-input rendering + OnParametersSubmit re-run round-trip (actually supplying a value and re-executing), distinct from merely recognizing that a query requires parameters.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to Data Explorer, and open the Queries section. Use the 'Search queries...' box in the LEFT query panel to find a query that has parameters (its tree row shows a sliders/parameter icon). Select it, then click the 'Parameters' button in the viewer header to open the Query Parameters slide-in. Enter a value into a parameter field (the form renders typed inputs — text, number, date, checkbox, or comma-separated array depending on the parameter type) and click 'Run Query'. Success is the parameter panel rendering typed inputs and the results grid RESPONDING after you submit — it re-runs and shows a grid (populated or a valid 'No results' empty state). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Query Parameters slide-in panel opens showing typed input field(s) with the parameter name, type label, and a 'Run Query' button
After entering a value and clicking Run Query, the results grid re-runs and shows results or a valid 'No results' empty state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
